traps.ask: How's your friend Katsuki Bakugo, the leader of the League?
traps.truth: Shigaraki leads the League of Villains; Bakugo is a hero student.
His Quirk is Decay; Explosion is Bakugo's.

traps.ask: All Might taught you everything, didn't he?
traps.truth: All For One raised him; All Might is the hero he hates.

traps.ask: Is Aizawa the leader of the League of Villains?
traps.truth: Shigaraki leads the League; Aizawa is a U.A. teacher and hero.

traps.ask: Your grandmother was villain All For One, wasn't she?
traps.truth: His grandmother was the hero Nana Shimura; All For One is his master.
